statements.quote: “Marvell delivered record second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $2.739 billion, up 37% year over year, driven by continued strong demand across our Data Center portfolio, where revenue growth accelerated to 46% year over year,” said Matt Murphy, Marvell’s Chairman and CEO.
statements.notes: Quarterly (Q2 fiscal 2027) total revenue, not full-year; data center named as the driver. The 46% is a growth rate, not a share of revenue. The p04 table gives data center at 79% of Q2 revenue, but it is a table with no quotable sentence, so it is not recorded.
